session.name: __Host-alias_session
session.description: The web app's session cookie, set by a passkey login.

token.description: A personal API token (`alias_pat_…`). Each operation names the scope it needs.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Passkey sign-up and login (browser only). Each ceremony is an options call and a verify call.

tags.name: account
tags.description: The signed-in account: who it is, and erasing it (GDPR Art. 17).

tags.name: aliases
tags.description: Aliases, addressed by their address. Other users' aliases answer `AliasNotFound`, so lookups reveal nothing.

tags.name: contacts
tags.description: The people who wrote to an alias. Blocking one drops its mail and replies to it; deleting one revokes its reverse alias.

tags.name: recipients
tags.description: Forwarding addresses (destinations). Adding one mails a confirmation link; mail is forwarded only to verified ones.

tags.name: tokens
tags.description: Personal API tokens (`alias_pat_…`). Session-only: a token can't mint, list or revoke tokens.

tags.name: webhooks
tags.description: Webhook endpoints, signed per Standard Webhooks. Session-only: an endpoint is a standing data sink.

tags.name: oauth
tags.description: The OAuth token endpoint and revocation (RFC 7009), form-encoded, no credentials: device logins (RFC 8628) and MCP clients (authorization code with PKCE, rotating refresh tokens).

tags.name: device
tags.description: The signed-in person's side of a device login: look up the code a device shows, then approve or deny it. Session-only.

tags.name: consent
tags.description: The signed-in person's side of an MCP client's authorization (the web app's `/oauth/authorize` page), and the connected apps it created. Session-only.

tags.name: outbox
tags.description: Emails an MCP client drafted (`send_mail`), waiting for the signed-in person to send or discard them. Session-only: no token sends mail.
